name: Plan
description: Codex and Claude inspect and cross-check one implementation plan without modifying the repository. Requires both providers.

steps.name: Independent plans
steps.promptTemplate:
Inspect the current repository and produce a precise implementation plan for this request without changing files.

{{userPrompt}}

steps.name: Converge on plan
steps.promptTemplate:
Cross-reference the other plan against the repository. Resolve omissions and unsupported assumptions. Return JSON only with fields candidate, accepted, objections, and unresolvedRisks. candidate is the plan itself: an object with title, summary, scope, steps, risks, acceptanceCriteria, and evidence. steps is a non-empty array of objects with id, intent, optional files, and optional verification. accepted is boolean. objections and unresolvedRisks are string arrays. Accept only the candidate you are returning.

{{peerAnswersTagged}}

steps.name: Surface material decisions
steps.promptTemplate:
Name only the material judgments this work leaves to the human. A judgment is material when the repository evidence cannot settle it, or when settling it commits the project to a direction a human owns.

Return JSON only: {"decisions": [...]}. Return an empty list when the work raised no such judgment; an empty list is the correct and common answer. Do not restate findings, operational blockers, provider errors, or choices this work already made on its own authority.

Every decision needs a stable subject, the actual question, the affected scope, and the evidence you are relying on. Supply options, trade-offs, and a recommendation only when the work genuinely produced them. Never invent an option, a trade-off, evidence, a scope, or a recommendation to fill a field.

{{peerAnswersTagged}}
